Nothing was re-run for this transcript: every isolation observation was recorded clean at its task, so the brief's re-run clause was never triggered. mutations.property: Address binding is a COMPARISON, not a blessing: a settled stress result belongs to the address it was computed FOR, and an edited input must flip the binding to 'stale' (barrier raised, result withheld) rather than letting the old result stand under the new address. Deleting the comparison makes every settled result read as current — the exact trust defect p0-1 fixes.
mutations.description: comparison deleted: addressBinding always returns the 'current' arm
mutations.command: e2e: npm run build && npx playwright test -c tests/playwright.p0.config.ts tests/e2e/p0-fixes.spec.ts -g "stale barrier" | unit: npx playwright test -c tests/playwright.p0.config.ts tests/unit/address-binding.spec.ts

edits.provenance: replace is LITERAL from task-1-report.md ('the return replaced with return { kind: "current", addr: phase.addr }; (comparison deleted)')

mutations.property: A settled matrix cell folds EVERY nonzero outcome dimension into its sub-line — deleting the bad-debt block lets bad debt move invisibly behind a cell that renders every other part, the '$0 while bad debt moved' defect p0-2 exists to kill.
mutations.command: npm run build && npx playwright test -c tests/playwright.p0.config.ts tests/e2e/p0-fixes.spec.ts -g "bad debt and shortfall"

edits.provenance: block-deletion per task-2-report.md ('Bad-debt block deleted from cellPrimaryOutcome'); the deleted block is the current tree's own text

mutations.property: The quiet arm is REACHABLE and honest: an all-zero engine says 'no effective movement' instead of parading zero-dollar deltas as outcomes. Forcing isZeroDecimal to false makes the quiet arm unreachable — every zero renders as a movement claim.
mutations.description: isZeroDecimal returns false unconditionally (quiet arm unreachable)
mutations.command: npm run build && npx playwright test -c tests/playwright.p0.config.ts tests/e2e/p0-fixes.spec.ts -g "all-zero engine"

edits.provenance: minimal reconstruction of task-2-report.md's recorded semantics ('isZeroDecimal → always false')

mutations.property: The value-arm row names HEALTH, not liquidation: the number is the lowest price at which the position is still healthy (ceil P*), not a liquidation trigger. Reverting the label to 'Liquidation price' restores the misnaming — and the presence of the OLD copy is itself pinned against (toHaveCount(0)), so the kill is observed at BOTH the rename-visibility assertion and the discriminating absence pin.

mutations.property: R6's arbitration is preserved one-to-one: while the age is UNRESOLVED the computed chip is NOT built — feeding snapshotChip the understated number the page just admitted it does not have restates the round-13 defect. Ignoring `unresolved` renders 'snapshot #1 · 2m old' where the refusal register must stand.
mutations.description: PostureRibbon passes snapshotChip(...) unconditionally, ignoring age.unresolved
